timeline.text: Welcome to Dreading the Day Before It Starts. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am already dreading this day.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Everything ahead feels heavy.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I wish I could avoid what is coming.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: My mind is running through the entire day.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels tense before I have even started.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not feel ready for this.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am judging myself for not feeling motivated.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit I want to stay here.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: The whole day feels like too much.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I do not have to live the whole day right now.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I only need to meet this morning.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can take the first step before the next one.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: The day may be different from what I imagine.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften before I begin.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can move without feeling fully ready.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: A hard morning does not decide the whole day.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can give myself a gentler start.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can make the day smaller.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am ready for the next ten minutes.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can meet one moment at a time.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to adapt as the day unfolds.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can notice what goes better than expected.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can move with steadiness.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not need perfect motivation to begin.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I have handled difficult days before.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can bring support with me.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to take the first step.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
